d:
Join me as I explore the stunning Fuldungri Hill, a hidden gem in Ghatshila, Jharkhand! Known for its serene landscapes, lush greenery, and breathtaking views, Fuldungri is a perfect getaway for nature lovers and adventure enthusiasts.
In this vlog, you'll experience:
A scenic trek to the top of Fuldungri Hill
Spectacular views of the Subarnarekha River and surrounding forests
The tranquility and natural charm of Ghatshila
Tips for visiting this beautiful location
